body.t: Select a coordinate and date to request a WMM magnetic-declination estimate. Enter a true bearing to see its magnetic equivalent. East and west declination change the correction direction; the model result is not a measurement of interference around a physical compass. Record the input and mode with any exported or reported result.

For an illustrative east declination of 5°, a true bearing of 100° becomes 95° magnetic. This arithmetic example does not assert that any selected location has 5° declination; calculate the model for your date and point.
